what_was_done: Frontend redesign: futuristic fonts (Outfit/Unbounded), glassmorphic tokens, cyberpunk colors.
CSS overhaul: base, topbar, chat, cards, charts, sdca, indicators — neon states, scan animations, 3D orb.
Pipeline fix: removed hard ticker requirement. Deterministic parser routes vague financials to market_scan.
Orchestrator guard: prevents CEO model from downgrading market_scan to needs_scope.
SDCA firewall: hard-block only for real trading decisions with ticker present.
Tested: 'quero uma dica de investimento' now runs full pipeline (market_scan -> 10 candidates -> CEO verdict).

python -m pytest tests/ -q -> 670 passed, 1 fixed (checkpoint), 0 remaining failures.
curl POST /task/submit 'quero uma dica de investimento' -> market_scan, 10 candidates, SDCA ALLOW, CEO volume anomaly shortlist.

CEO intent classifier timeout may cause deterministic_final fallback on first request after cold start.
